title: Websites for gyms and fitness studios | Creosote Labs
meta_description: Creosote Labs builds marketing sites, waiver and intake forms, training booking, and member portals for gyms and studios. Fixed-price, quoted after a call.
h1: Website and web application development for gyms and fitness studios
intro: Gym and studio websites often consist of a template site with a class schedule pulled in from Mindbody or Glofox, a pricing page maintained by hand, and a contact form that delivers to a shared inbox. Membership sign-up and trial booking happen on the platform's hosted pages, which look different from the rest of the site. Waivers are often signed on a tablet at the front desk, and personal training is frequently booked by text message.

Creosote Labs builds marketing sites and customer-facing tools for fitness businesses. A marketing site lists classes, memberships, and pricing plainly, with trial booking and contact on every page. Customer tools include online waiver and intake forms, personal-training booking, and a member portal for package balances and schedule changes. Where the studio wants to replace a platform feature, we build a web application for it. Hosting, domain setup, and handover documentation are included.
projects: A marketing site with class descriptions, membership tiers, and a trial-class booking form that posts to the membership platform.
An online waiver and health-intake form that new members complete before their first visit.
A personal-training booking page that shows each trainer's availability and takes a deposit through Square or Stripe.
A member portal for viewing package balances, freezing a membership, and updating payment details.
A schedule page that reads directly from Mindbody or Mariana Tek so it does not go out of date.

faqs.q: How is a website project priced?
faqs.a: Projects are quoted after a scoping call. The quote is a fixed price for the agreed scope, with no hourly billing. Hosting and domain configuration are part of the project.

faqs.q: Can the site connect to our membership software?
faqs.a: Yes, where the platform offers an integration or an export. Mindbody, Glofox, WellnessLiving, and similar platforms provide schedule widgets or APIs that a site can read from, so bookings and schedules stay in one place.

faqs.q: What do we need to provide?
faqs.a: The project needs current class and membership information, pricing, photos, a logo, and access to the domain registrar and membership platform. Copy is written from that material during the project.
